title: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
method: Boil the pasta and set aside
Add oil to a pan, add in the garlic and onion
Add in the sliced mushrooms and cook till water releases
Add in oregano + chilli flakes + salt + pepper and stir together
Add in vegetable stock and cream and stir together
Add in the cooked pasta and let it mix together with the sauce
As it cooks for 3-4 minutes, the liquid does thicken along with the starch from the noodles giving you a creamy base but not needing so much cream as per standard recipes
Add in fresh basil and cheese (optional)
tips: Add a cooked chicken breast on top to add 30+ grams of protein to this meal :)
caption:
Creamy Mushroom Pasta
lite version | lunch box recipe 

Nutrition: 
C: 48 | F: 12 | P: 13
Calories: 358 per serve 
Makes 2 servings

Ingredients
1 tsp olive oil
5-6 cloves of garlic, minced
1/2 onion, sliced
200 grams button mushroom, sliced
oregano + chilli flakes
salt + pepper 
1/2 cup vegetable stock
1/8 cup amul cream 
fresh basil
30 grams grated gouda cheese 
100 grams pasta of choice

Method 
boil the pasta and set aside
add oil to a pan, add in the garlic and onion 
add in the sliced mushrooms and cook till water releases 
add in oregano + chilli flakes + salt + pepper and stir together
add in vegetable stock and cream and stir together 
add in the cooked pasta and let it mix together with the sauce
as it cooks for 3-4 minutes, the liquid does thicken along with the starch from the noodles giving you a creamy base but not needing so much cream as per standard recipes 
add in fresh basil and cheese (optional)

pro tip: 
add a cooked chicken breast on top to add 30+ grams of protein to this meal :)
